tab.title: FAQ
tab.cardSubtitle: These FAQs are rendered on the product page.
tab.helpTextOrder: The selection order defines the order in the storefront.
tab.emptyStateDescription: Select FAQs above or assign an FAQ category or FAQ tag.
tab.cardSubtitleRules: FAQs are added automatically based on FAQ category or FAQ tag, without selecting them one by one.
tab.helpTextRuleCategories: All active FAQs of these categories are rendered on the product page.
tab.helpTextRuleTags: All active FAQs carrying at least one of these tags are rendered.
tab.cardSubtitlePreview: Manually assigned FAQs come first, followed by the automatically resolved ones.
tab.hintSave: Changes on this tab are stored together with the product, using the save button in the top right corner.
tab.notificationPreviewError: The preview could not be loaded.
